WITH customer_counts AS (
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) as count 
  FROM customer 
  GROUP BY store_id
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total 
  FROM customer_counts
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT cc.store_id, cc.count, cc.count * 1.0 / ts.total as count_div_total
  FROM customer_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
  WHERE ts.total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_val
  FROM with_ratios
)
SELECT wr.store_id, wr.count, wr.count_div_total, wr.count - ac.avg_val as count_minus_avg
FROM with_ratios wr
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE ac.avg_val IS NOT NULL
